attribution.modifications: Original texture-free low-poly reconstruction: flat-roofed stone-faced guard-house wings with brick side walls flanking a sandstone triumphal-arch centre (one carriage arch, two pedestrian arches) crowned by an octagonal grey slate/lead dome with a stone clock lantern and spire. Surveyed BAG parent and 3DBAG height; arch proportions, dome profile and heraldic pediment relief simplified from photographs. No imported mesh geometry or reference-image pixels.
